title: docs(issue_template): add a "solution proposal" question
body:
<!--
  Thanks for submitting a pull request!

**Summary**

Add a "propose solution" section to the issue section.

This is useful if whoever writes the issue already knows how to solve a certain bug.


**Result**

There's a new section called "Bug: What is the proposed solution?"
